title: Attention as Soft Lookup
summary: Attention as a soft dictionary lookup: queries score keys, softmax turns scores into weights, and values are mixed accordingly, with scaling, batching and causal masking done right.
takeaways: Each query is compared with every key. Softmax turns the scores into weights over the values.
Divide scores by √d_k so softmax doesn't saturate when dimensions are large.
Transpose only the last two axes (swapaxes), never .T, when tensors are batched.
A causal mask sets future positions to −∞ before softmax, so they get exactly zero weight.

steps.label: Project
steps.detail: Q = XW_q, K = XW_k, V = XW_v.

steps.label: Score
steps.detail: S = Q @ Kᵀ, a (T_q, T_k) matrix of similarities.

steps.label: Scale + mask
steps.detail: S / √d_k, then set disallowed (future) positions to −∞.

steps.label: Softmax
steps.detail: Row-wise softmax over keys; each row sums to 1.

terms.definition: Learned projections: queries ask, keys are matched against, values are what gets mixed.
softmax(QKᵀ/√d_k)V, the core operation of the transformer.
A lower-triangular mask so position i can attend only to positions ≤ i.
Without positions, permuting input tokens permutes outputs identically.
